one_liner: YQuantum develops miniaturized hardware components for quantum computers and is worth meeting after its 2026 recognition as an ETH Zurich spin-off.

top_signals.signal: ETH Zurich recognized YQuantum on its 2026 spin-off roster.
YQuantum received CHF 150,000 in seed funding from Venture Kick in November 2025.

Model score 84.5 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). The score was lifted by flags for university spin-off status, deep tech, three identified founders, a founder with a PhD, a founding CTO, and a founder from a top university. The technical-founder flag also lifted the score but is not confirmed by the founder records.

team: The founder records list Dr. Christian Jünger (CEO; University of Basel; previously at QuantrolOx), Dr. Johannes Herrmann (CTO; ETH Zurich), and Prof. em. Dr. Christian Schönenberger (Scientific Advisor; University of Basel). All three hold PhDs.
